description: This file contains utility functions related to displaying UI components for Prospect Lists in SuiteCRM, including JavaScript validation and HTML form creation.

classes.name: ProspectListFormBase
classes.description: A class responsible for generating the HTML form to create or edit prospect list records.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation of form data when creating or editing a prospect list.

methods.name: get_new_record_form
methods.description: Creates and returns an HTML form for entering a new Prospect List record by utilizing the ProspectListFormBase class.
